question: How do I apply for admission?
answer: Fill in the online application form on the admissions portal, upload the required documents, and pay the application fee. You will receive a confirmation email once the form is submitted.
aliases: How to join the college; How can a new student enroll; College admission procedure; Steps for getting admission

question: What is the last date to apply?
answer: The application deadline is announced on the admissions page each year. Applications submitted after the deadline may be considered only if seats remain.
aliases: Application submission deadline; Until what date are applications accepted; When do applications close

question: When is the application deadline?
answer: The application deadline is announced on the admissions page each year. Applications submitted after the deadline may be considered only if seats remain.

question: What are the eligibility criteria for undergraduate programs?
answer: Applicants normally need to have completed higher secondary education (12th grade or equivalent) with the minimum marks set by the programme. Some programmes also require an entrance exam score.

question: Which documents are required for admission?
answer: Usually: mark sheets of previous qualifications, a transfer certificate, an identity proof, passport-size photographs, and a category certificate if applicable. Keep both originals and photocopies ready.
aliases: What paperwork is needed to join; Which certificates are needed during enrollment; Documents to submit when joining college

question: Is there an entrance exam for admission?
answer: Some programmes admit students based on an entrance exam score, others on previous academic marks. The admissions page lists the accepted exams for each programme.

question: How much is the application fee?
answer: A non-refundable application fee is charged when you submit the form. The exact amount is shown on the application portal.

question: How can I check my application status?
answer: Log in to the admissions portal with your registered email and application number. The status page shows whether your application is received, under review, or decided.
aliases: How to see admission application progress; Has my application been reviewed; Where can I see my admission decision

question: Can I transfer from another college?
answer: Lateral and credit transfers are possible subject to seat availability and equivalence of courses. Submit your transcripts to the admissions office for evaluation.

question: Do you accept international students?
answer: Yes. International applicants must submit a valid passport, previous academic records, and proof of English proficiency. Contact the international office for visa guidance.

question: Can I change my course after admission?
answer: Programme changes are allowed in limited cases during the first year, subject to seat availability, eligibility, and approval from both departments.

question: When will the classes for the new academic year begin?
answer: Start dates are published in the academic calendar. New students also attend an orientation programme before classes begin.

question: How do I pay the tuition fees?
answer: Tuition fees can be paid online through the student portal using net banking, debit or credit card, or UPI. Offline payment by demand draft is also accepted at the accounts office.
aliases: Tuition payment methods; How can I make a college fee payment; Ways to pay education fees

question: What is the tuition fee for a program?
answer: Tuition fees differ by programme and are listed in the fee structure document on the website. The accounts office can give you an exact breakdown.

question: Can I pay the fees in installments?
answer: Many programmes allow fees to be paid in two or more instalments. Request the instalment option from the accounts office before the first due date.
aliases: Can tuition be paid in parts; Is split payment allowed for fees; Can I pay fees monthly

question: What is the last date to pay the fees?
answer: Fee due dates are listed in the fee schedule. A late fine may apply after the due date, so pay on time.

question: How do I get a tuition fee refund?
answer: Refund requests must be submitted in writing to the accounts office. Refund amounts depend on how early you withdraw, according to the institution's refund policy.
aliases: Can I get my tuition money back; Refund policy for paid fees; How to request a fee reimbursement

question: Are scholarships available?
answer: Yes. Merit-based and need-based scholarships are available, along with government schemes. Check the scholarship page for eligibility and deadlines.
aliases: Does the college offer financial aid; Can students receive scholarship support; Scholarship options for students

question: How can I apply for a scholarship?
answer: Fill in the scholarship application on the student portal and upload income and academic documents. The scholarship committee reviews applications and announces results.
aliases: Steps to submit a scholarship application; Where do I submit scholarship documents; Scholarship application procedure

question: Is there any education loan assistance?
answer: The finance office can provide fee certificates and guidance for education loans. Several partner banks offer loans to admitted students.

question: Is there a fee waiver for economically weaker students?
answer: Fee concessions may be available for eligible students. Submit a request with income proof to the scholarship committee.

question: Which payment methods are accepted for fees?
answer: Net banking, debit and credit cards, UPI, and demand drafts are accepted. Cash payment is usually not accepted.

question: Where can I find the academic calendar?
answer: The academic calendar is on the university website and the student portal. It lists semester dates, holidays, and exam weeks.

question: What is the minimum attendance required?
answer: Most programmes require a minimum attendance, commonly 75 percent, to be eligible for the semester exams. Check your department's regulations for the exact figure.
aliases: Required attendance percentage for exams; How much class attendance is compulsory; Attendance eligibility for semester exams

question: What happens if my attendance is low?
answer: Students with low attendance may be barred from the exams. In genuine cases such as illness, you can apply for condonation with supporting documents.
aliases: Consequences of shortage of attendance; Will low attendance stop me from taking exams; Attendance shortage rules

question: How is the CGPA calculated?
answer: CGPA is the credit-weighted average of grade points across all completed courses. Each course's grade point is multiplied by its credits, summed, and divided by total credits.
aliases: How to calculate grade point average; How are semester grades combined; Method used to work out CGPA

question: How can I check my exam results?
answer: Results are published on the student portal after each exam cycle. Log in with your student ID to view and download your grade sheet.
aliases: Where are semester marks published; How can I view my grades; How to see examination marks online

question: When will the semester exam timetable be released?
answer: The exam timetable is normally released a few weeks before the exams on the notice board and the student portal.

question: How do I apply for revaluation of my answer sheet?
answer: Apply for revaluation on the student portal within the notified window after results and pay the revaluation fee. The revised result is announced after review.
aliases: How to request exam paper rechecking; Can my answer script be reviewed again; Procedure for rechecking exam marks

question: What if I fail a subject?
answer: You can appear for the supplementary exam for failed subjects. Check the exam office notice for registration dates and fees.

question: How do I register for courses each semester?
answer: Course registration opens on the student portal before each semester. Choose your courses and get approval from your faculty advisor.

question: How many credits do I need to graduate?
answer: Each programme sets a total credit requirement. Your programme handbook lists the compulsory and elective credits needed for the degree.

question: Can I take a semester break?
answer: A semester break can be approved for medical or personal reasons. Apply to the dean's office with supporting documents before the semester begins.

question: Are there any online courses or certifications offered?
answer: Students can take approved online courses and earn credits or certificates. Ask your department for the list of recognised platforms.

question: How do I apply for hostel accommodation?
answer: Fill in the hostel application form on the student portal and pay the hostel deposit. Rooms are allotted based on availability and the allotment policy.
aliases: How to get a room in the student hostel; Hostel admission procedure; How can I request hostel lodging

question: How do I cancel my hostel allotment?
answer: Submit a written hostel cancellation request to the warden. The deposit refund is processed after room inspection and clearance of dues.
aliases: How to withdraw from hostel accommodation; I no longer need my hostel room; Process for hostel cancellation

question: What are the hostel fees?
answer: Hostel fees depend on the room type and whether meals are included. The fee structure is available on the hostel page.

question: What are the library timings?
answer: The library is typically open on weekdays from morning to evening, with extended hours during exams. Check the notice at the library entrance for current timings.
aliases: Library opening and closing hours; When is the college library open; At what time does the library close

question: How many books can I borrow from the library?
answer: Students can borrow a fixed number of books for a set period using their ID card. Overdue books attract a daily fine.
aliases: Library book borrowing limit; How many library books may I check out; Rules for borrowing books

question: Is there Wi-Fi on campus?
answer: Yes. Campus-wide Wi-Fi is available in classrooms, libraries, and hostels. Log in with your student credentials.
aliases: Does the college provide wireless internet; Can students connect to campus internet; Internet access at college

question: Is there a bus facility for students?
answer: The college runs buses on several routes. Register for the transport service at the transport office and pay the transport fee.
aliases: Does the college have student buses; College transportation service; How can I travel to college by bus

question: Is there a medical facility on campus?
answer: A health centre with a doctor and basic medical care is available on campus. Emergency cases are referred to the nearest hospital.
aliases: Is a doctor available at college; Where can students get first aid; Campus health centre services

question: What sports facilities are available?
answer: Playgrounds, indoor game rooms, and a gym are available. Students can join sports teams and take part in inter-college tournaments.

question: Which student clubs can I join?
answer: There are technical, cultural, literary, and social service clubs. Club recruitment is announced at the start of each semester.

question: What food options are available on campus?
answer: The mess and campus canteens serve vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals. Menus are displayed at the mess entrance.

question: How do I get a student ID card?
answer: Your ID card is issued after you complete admission formalities. Collect it from the administrative office with your admission receipt.
aliases: How to receive my college identity card; Where can I collect my student card; Student identity card issuance

question: What should I do if I lose my ID card?
answer: Report the loss to the administrative office and apply for a duplicate ID card. A small fee is charged for the replacement.
aliases: Procedure for a missing student card; How to replace a lost college identity card; I cannot find my student identification card

question: Does the college provide placement assistance?
answer: Yes. The training and placement cell conducts aptitude and interview training and invites companies for campus recruitment.
aliases: Does college help students find jobs; Career placement support for students; Job training and campus recruitment help

question: Which companies visit the campus for placements?
answer: A variety of companies from IT, core engineering, and services recruit on campus. The placement cell publishes the list of recruiters each year.
aliases: Campus recruitment company list; Which employers recruit college students; Companies that hire through campus drives

question: How can I get an internship?
answer: Watch the placement cell notices for internship openings and apply through the portal. You can also apply directly to companies with your department's permission letter.

question: Can the placement cell help me with my resume?
answer: The placement cell runs resume-building workshops and mock interviews. Book a slot with the career counsellor for one-to-one feedback.

question: How can I get my transcript?
answer: Apply for an official transcript at the examination office through the student portal and pay the transcript fee. Processing takes a few working days.
aliases: How to request an academic transcript; Where can I obtain my marks transcript; Transcript application procedure

question: How do I get a bonafide certificate?
answer: Request a bonafide certificate through the student portal or the administrative office. It is usually issued within a few working days.

question: How do I get a transfer certificate?
answer: Apply to the administrative office after clearing all dues and library records. The transfer certificate is issued once clearance is complete.

question: What are the office working hours?
answer: Administrative offices are generally open on weekdays during regular business hours and closed on Sundays and public holidays.

question: How can I contact the college?
answer: You can reach the college by phone or email listed on the Contact Us page, or visit the front office during working hours.
aliases: College office phone number and email; How to reach the college administration; Contact details for the institution

question: How do I update my contact details?
answer: Update your phone number and email on the student portal, or submit a request form to the administrative office.

question: How can I file a complaint or grievance?
answer: Submit your complaint through the grievance cell or the online grievance form. The committee reviews it and replies within a stipulated time.

question: What is the anti-ragging policy?
answer: Ragging is strictly prohibited and punishable. Report any incident to the anti-ragging committee or the helpline, and your identity will be handled sensitively.
aliases: How do I report bullying or ragging; Rules against ragging on campus; Who should I contact about ragging

question: When is the convocation held?
answer: Convocation is usually held once a year. Eligible graduates register on the portal and are informed of the date by email.

question: Is there an alumni association?
answer: Yes. Graduates can join the alumni association to network, mentor students, and attend alumni events.

question: Is parking available for students?
answer: Designated parking areas exist for two-wheelers and cars. Register your vehicle at the security office to get a parking sticker.
